summary: The filing is an 8-K made by Science Applications International Corp. (SAIC) on August 27, 2026, solely to disclose that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.37 per share, payable October 23, 2026, to stockholders of record October 9, 2026. The press release notes intention to continue quarterly dividends but states future declarations depend on conditions. This is a routine capital-return event, not a special situation such as a tender, going private, or strategic review. No unusual terms, advisors, or structural complexities are present; the filing is purely informational with no risk-arb angle.
